question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The mother ________ the chips because they were soggy.
solution:
The correct answer is: **discarded**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"discarded"** means to throw away or get rid of something that is no longer useful or desirable. (त्यागना)

 
 
• **Example:** She discarded the old magazines because they were cluttering up the room.
 
 
 
• **"Soggy"** refers to something that is wet and soft, often in an unpleasant way. (गीला और नरम)
 
• Hence, we can infer that the mother would **discard **the chips because they were soggy and not desirable to eat.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

**Complete Sentence:** *The mother discarded__ the chips because they were soggy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Saved** (बचाया): To keep something for future use.

 
 
• **Example:** She **saved **the leftover cake for later.
 
 
 
• **Wasted** (बर्बाद किया): To use something carelessly or without purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** He **wasted **all the water by leaving the tap on.
 
 
 
• **Recovered** (वापस पाया): To get back something lost or to regain health.
 
 
• **Example:** She **recovered **her lost wallet from the police station.
